title: 第1744章 而是另有其人第1743章 时光静谧岁月安然
slug: 横推九世诸位女帝一直在等我
content_zh:
来人一头碧色长发精致挽起，发髻点缀着华美繁复的发饰，流光婉转，精致夺目。
那张绝美清丽的脸庞明艳灵动，既有邻家少女的鲜活烂漫，又自带一份不染尘俗的缥缈仙气，灵动又惊艳。
是柳梦兮。
甫一现身，她便毫无顾忌地扑入忆无情怀中，双臂紧紧环住他的腰身，贪恋地依偎着，满心思念尽数倾泻。
忆无情无奈又宠溺地轻笑，抬手轻轻拍抚着她的后背，温声开口：
“好久不见，梦兮。”
柳梦兮缓缓从他怀中抬头，一双剔透碧绿的眼眸亮晶晶的，盛满浓烈的思念与欢喜，软软出声：
“无情哥哥，梦兮好想你。”
“我也很想你。”
忆无情眉眼温柔，含笑打趣，
“我还以为，你爹不会放你前来永恒古星。”
“嘿嘿，老爹不肯松口，但是娘亲疼我，应允我来啦！”
柳梦兮眉眼弯弯，笑得明媚狡黠，满心欢喜。
闻言，忆无情眉头一动，“哦？你娘亲同意你来？”
“当然啦，娘亲最好了。”
柳梦兮笑了笑。
“嗯……”
忆无情若有所思。
紧随其后，一袭蓝衣素净雅致的元霜月缓步踏入殿中。
她立在冷清璃身侧，二人皆是蓝发蓝衣，气质清冷如雪、绝尘似霜，身形气质隐隐相似，

宛若一对跌落凡尘的冰雪仙子，静谧淡然，不染烟火。
元霜月抬眸望向冷清璃，身姿微躬，礼数周全：“星主。”
“我早已不是极寒星主了。”
冷清璃无奈失笑，语气温和，“不必再这般唤我。”
“于我心中，你永远是极寒星主。”
元霜月眸光澄澈，带着几分执拗的坚定，未曾半分退让。
“好好好，依你便是。”
冷清璃拗不过她，只得温柔应下。
“霜月，过来坐。”
忆无情笑着抬手招呼。
怀中的柳梦兮也十分乖巧地稍稍退开，松开怀抱，给他留出空隙。
忆无情环顾殿内众人，目光扫过四周，微微疑惑：
“对了，如仙怎么未见人影？”
“在……在这里。”
一道轻柔羞怯的女声缓缓响起。
道如仙的倩影悄然立至忆无情身前，一身素白朴素的道袍贴身而覆，制式简约干净，褪去了平日天女的华贵庄重。
可这般素雅衣衫，非但不显寡淡，反倒愈发衬得她容颜圣洁无瑕、气质清冷绝尘，自带一股清冷禁欲的脱俗气韵，清绝动人。
content_en:
The visitor's long green hair was exquisitely pulled up, and the bun was decorated with gorgeous and complicated hair accessories. It was flowing gracefully and exquisitely eye-catching.
That absolutely beautiful and clear face is bright and smart. It has the liveliness and brilliance of the girl next door, but also has an ethereal fairy spirit that is not stained by the worldly world. It is smart and stunning.
It's Liu Mengxi.
As soon as she appeared, she threw herself into Yi Qingqing's arms without any scruples, wrapped her arms tightly around his waist, and clung to him greedily, pouring out all her thoughts in her heart.
Yi Wuqing chuckled helplessly and dotingly, raised his hand to gently pat her back, and spoke warmly:
"Long time no see, Mengxi."
Liu Mengxi slowly raised her head from his arms, with a pair of bright green eyes, full of strong longing and joy, and said softly:
"Brother Qingqing, Mengxi misses you so much."
"I miss you too."
Yi Qingqing has gentle eyebrows and a joking smile,
"I thought your father wouldn't let you come to Eternal Ancient Star."
"Hey, daddy won't let go, but mommy loves me so much that she allowed me to come!"
Liu Mengxi's eyebrows were curved, her smile was bright and cunning, and she was filled with joy.
Hearing this, Yi Qingqing frowned, "Oh? Your mother agrees to your coming?"
"Of course, mother is the best."
Liu Mengxi smiled.
"Well..."
Recalling Wuqing thoughtfully.
Immediately after, Yuan Shuangyue, dressed plainly and elegantly in blue, slowly stepped into the hall.
She stood beside Leng Qingli. Both of them had blue hair and blue clothes. Their temperaments were as cold as snow and dusty as frost. Their bodies and temperaments were vaguely similar.
Like a pair of ice and snow fairies who have fallen into the mortal world, they are quiet and indifferent, not stained by fireworks.
Yuan Shuangyue raised her eyes to look at Leng Qingli, bowed slightly, and said politely: "Star Lord."
"I am no longer the Lord of Extreme Cold Star."
Leng Qingli smiled helplessly and said in a gentle tone, "No need to call me like that again."
"In my heart, you will always be the Lord of Extreme Cold Star."
Yuan Shuangyue's eyes were clear, with a bit of stubborn determination, and she never gave in.
"Okay, okay, it's up to you."
Leng Qingli couldn't resist her, so she had to agree gently.
"Shuangyue, come and sit."
Yi Qingqing smiled and raised her hand to say hello.
Liu Mengxi in her arms also very obediently stepped away slightly, loosened her arms, and left a gap for him.
Yi Wuqing looked around at the people in the hall, glanced around, and was slightly confused:
"By the way, why is Ruxian no one seen?"
"Here...here."
A soft and shy female voice slowly sounded.
The Taoist-like figure quietly stood in front of Yi Qingqing. She was wearing a plain white Taoist robe that covered her body. The style was simple and clean, and it had faded away from the luxury and solemnity of the ordinary goddess.
But such simple and elegant clothes, instead of looking dull, actually make her look more holy and flawless, and her temperament is cold and dust-free. It has a cool and ascetic air of being free from vulgarity, which is pure and moving.
